title: WPMS/720/2008 of Km. Pramila Vs Smt. Sunita Giri and Anr

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
WRIT PETITION (MS) NO. 720 of 2008
Km. Pramila .................Petitioner.
Vs.
Smt. Sunita Giri and another. ...Respondents
Dated: 13.09. 2019
Ramesh Ranganathan, C.J.
Since the counsel for the petitioner could no longer appear
consequent on his elevation to the Bench, notice was issued to the
petitioner on 31.08.2018. The said notice was returned unserved in
December, 2018 with the endorsement that 'notice could not be
served due to insufficient address'. Thereafter, a fresh notice was
directed to be issued to the petitioner. The notice, issued by the
Registry on 17.12.2018, was returned unserved on 16.05.2019 with
the endorsement 'insufficient address'.
2. Notices on both the occasions were sent to the address
furnished by the petitioner as reflected in the cause title of the writ
petition.
3. The petitioner has chosen not to appoint another counsel or to
appear in the matter. The notices sent to her were returned unserved
on the ground of insufficient address. As the petitioner has chosen not
to prosecute the case, I am constrained, in such circumstances, to
dismiss the writ petition for non-prosecution.
 (Ramesh Ranganathan, C.J.)
 13.09.2019
Rathour
